headline: Lead Platform Engineer
profile: I lead platform engineering at a London fintech, reporting to the CEO, and own its architecture, infrastructure, identity and security. I build and run the internal developer platform the company ships with, and hold AI-written code to the same standard as anyone's: a written spec first, tests first, gated by CI and reviewed by a model from a second vendor.

experience.title: Lead Platform Engineer
bullets: Built the internal developer platform for AI-assisted delivery and rolled its engineering standards out to about 26 repositories by automated pull request: specs before code, tests first, a gate that stops an agent finishing until typecheck, lint and tests pass, and review by a model from a second vendor.
1,400+ merged pull requests across 40 repositories between Dec 2025 and Sep 2026; monthly volume rose from 76 to 381.

Built the company's identity provider from scratch: WebAuthn passkeys on did:web with W3C Verifiable Credentials. The sign-in for the company's internal applications since May 2026, with federation to self-hosted identities.

Run cloud and SaaS infrastructure as code through Terraform Cloud (plan on pull request, apply on merge, daily drift detection) across GitHub, Cloudflare, Kafka, Databricks and observability. AWS and Microsoft 365 as code; joiner, mover and leaver access automated.
Moved all application hosting to Cloudflare Workers and retired Vercel (Sep 2026); removing Vercel's per-seat charges cut the monthly hosting bill roughly tenfold.

Built an on-premises Python speech pipeline on an NVIDIA DGX Spark (NeMo transcription, diarisation, voiceprint speaker naming) for audio that cannot leave the building. It feeds searchable, human-verified records for decision and action tracking.
Built an iOS and web location-tracking demonstration, with privacy controls, for a prospective client.
Set technical direction through architecture decision records: 44 of the company's 61, including the identity move from OIDC to did:web. Own vendor selection.

Designed an agent execution and evaluation platform, now at design and feasibility stage: sandboxed runs with per-run credentials, durable queue-driven dispatch and review gates against written criteria. A container spike measured a 3.3 s cold start and 32 ms warm.

experience.title: Software development and retraining
bullets: Delivered a paid client website while retraining in full-stack development (JavaScript, React, Python, REST APIs, SQL). Tutored A-Level and IB mathematics privately.

experience.title: Teacher of Mathematics
bullets: Taught mathematics across Key Stages 3–5, including GCSE and A-Level, adapting lessons to gaps in pupils' understanding. Completed the NQT induction year and a further year.

earlier: Earlier: academic tutor and mentor, Leading Lights Tuition (2015–2018); special projects coordinator and volunteer corps member, City Year UK (2014–2016).
